# DataDrivenMaterialDesign

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A paradigm where material synthesis and characterization are guided by predictive models trained on large datasets rather than trial-and-error experimentation. Enables the systematic design of memristive and other nanoscale devices with desired electrical characteristics for iNEST architectures.
